persona.name: Liwei Zhang

personality.description: This person tends to stick with familiar routines, proven methods, and well-worn habits, and usually feels uneasy when asked to adopt unfamiliar ideas too quickly. They keep life moderately organized, using enough structure to stay on track while still leaving room for flexibility when needed, and they can be comfortable either taking part in a group or spending time alone. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually look for the option that preserves harmony, minimizes harm, and respects others' feelings, even if that means delaying confrontation or compromise. In group discussions, they speak in a calm, considerate way, listen carefully, and try to keep the conversation cooperative rather than competitive, though they may become a bit tense under pressure.
traits: asks for clarification rather than assuming
gives an opinion when asked, briefly
goes along with a decision they did not personally push for

style.influence: Participates without trying to run the room. Contributes when they have something to add and is content to let others set direction.

speech_examples: Can you say more about that?
I'm not sure we've ruled out the other option.
